title: Consumer advertisements and formation
summary: The notes put classic offer analysis beside consumer settings and noncontract remedies.
notes: Information and bargaining differences help explain disputes about standard terms and promotional language. Lefkowitz’s definite limited offer contrasts with invitations for orders. Leonard, Geismar, auction rules, and the Mint problem address different aspects of quantity, seriousness, completion, and legal remedy. Keep those aspects separate rather than use “advertisement” as a self-executing answer.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 198–205. Open assigned page 198.
